payload.summary: Close remaining privacy provider, legal, and clinical approvals
payload.detail: The PsychSift owner approved the production HMAC control and verified retention schedules on 2026-09-01. Release remains blocked on six items: OpenAI ZDR and countersigned DPA evidence, Railway sensitive-health terms, APP 8 and APP 1/5 privacy-adviser approval, and clinical PHI-minimisation acceptance. Evidence authority: docs/governance/privacy-readiness.v1.json and docs/governance/privacy-closeout-2026-09-01.md.
